visibleInputs: data/replays/e08-bge-m3/embeddings.json (vectors recorded once from the local Ollama bge-m3; replayed, hash-checked per text)
hypothesis: A local embedding model (bge-m3) finds the relevant case by meaning: the fusion with bge-m3 in place of the trigram list keeps recall@3 and the lookalike rejection of the shipped hybrid on the hash-locked splits, and finds the judge's paraphrased problem that the lexical lists miss.

variants.description: bge-m3 embeddings alone (evidence, claims and case cards; cosine aggregated to the case by max), replayed from data/replays
the shipped fusion: BM25 + exact id + local trigram, reciprocal rank fusion
the fusion with the embed slot on: BM25 + exact id + bge-m3 in place of the trigram list (what embed=local runs)

config.index: evidence text, live claim statements and case cards (memory/case-card.ts), indexed once after the import; brute-force cosine, hits below 0.3 dropped, aggregated to the case by max; the embed list is pruned at 0.75 of its best hit (retrieval/hybrid.ts defaults)
config.testSplit: not opened: the test split was opened once for E02/E04 (results/e02-test, e04-test); E08 stays on demo/train/validation
config.lookalikeDefinition: top-1 candidate case maps to an incident outside key.relatedIncidentKeys, over problems tagged lookalike-different-cause; rejection = 1 - that rate over the same denominator

texts: The lamp on the box is green, yet no data gets through to the customer.
Everything on the unit looks healthy, but the customer is still getting nothing.
paraphraseProbe.store: the demo store as demo:reset --synthetic builds it (demo families + dev fixture)
paraphraseProbe.target: TRN-042 when the Elisa files are present, else its stand-in TRN-117 (optic-forwarding-a)

acceptanceCriteria: On validation: hybrid+embed recall@3 >= hybrid-rrf recall@3 AND hybrid+embed lookalike-top-1 rate <= hybrid-rrf's -> embed=local may be offered as the opt-in embed slot for the demo; else the embed slot stays rules by default and the result is reported as is. (The default is rules either way; nothing is enabled silently.)
Paraphrase probe: reported per retriever as the rank of the target case (null = not in the top 8); not a pass/fail criterion.
Any embedding fallback (no recording, mismatch) in replay mode fails the run.
